paragraphs: The X4 xDrive20i and xDrive28i are petrol variants within the X4 range, spanning the first-generation F26 model from 2014 to 2018. Across this generation, the xDrive20i/xDrive28i used two different 2.0-litre four-cylinder engines: the earlier N20, fitted to pre-2016 cars, and the later B48, introduced as a running change from 2016 onward. Both are turbocharged petrol units, but they're different engine families — the B48 represents BMW's newer modular engine architecture, with a different block design and revised internals. Knowing which one your car has matters for both parts compatibility and the known service patterns, which is why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: The X4 xDrive28i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol fitted to the X4 xDrive20i/xDrive28i from 2014 to 2016. Known for timing chain guide failure where fitted in pre-2016 cars — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, guides, tensioners and gaskets as standard on every N20 rebuild.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre turbocharged four-cylinder petrol fitted to the X4 xDrive20i/xDrive28i from 2016 to 2018. A later design that resolved the N20's timing chain guide weakness; no confirmed issue pattern for this engine in this application. We service it to the same standard as our other X4 rebuilds, with the same parts-quality standard throughout.

compatibility.intro: Because the X4 xDrive20i/xDrive28i spans two distinct engines across the same generation, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming an N20 part will work on a B48 car — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (N20 or B48) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic X4 quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
